info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Routing Decisions API
info.description: The Routing Decisions API facilitates the intelligent routing of card transaction requests within banking operational services. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can dynamically determine the most appropriate processing paths for card transactions, enhancing efficiency and improving service delivery. This API is designed for financial institutions and payment processors needing to optimize transaction flows based on real-time decision-making algorithms. Typical consumers include banking application developers and payment gateway providers aiming to implement seamless transaction management solutions.

post.summary: Create routing decisions for card transaction switches.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of routing decisions for card transaction switches. It helps in determining the optimal routing paths for transaction processing, enhancing reliability and efficiency in transaction handling.
